entries.title: Job 30:1
segments: ¶But now those who are younger than I make sport of me; those whose fathers I would not have put with the dogs of my flocks.

entries.title: Job 30:2
segments: Of what use is the strength of their hands to me? all force is gone from them.

entries.title: Job 30:3
segments: They are wasted for need of food, biting the dry earth; their only hope of life is in the waste land.

entries.title: Job 30:4
segments: They are pulling off the salt leaves from the brushwood, and making a meal of roots.

entries.title: Job 30:5
segments: They are sent out from among their townsmen, men are crying after them as thieves

entries.title: Job 30:6
segments: They have to get a resting-place in the hollows of the valleys, in holes of the earth and rocks.

entries.title: Job 30:7
segments: They make noises like asses among the brushwood; they get together under the thorns.

entries.title: Job 30:8
segments: They are sons of shame, and of men without a name, who have been forced out of the land.

entries.title: Job 30:9
segments: And now I have become their song, and I am a word of shame to them.

entries.title: Job 30:10
segments: I am disgusting to them; they keep away from me, and put marks of shame on me.

entries.title: Job 30:11
segments: For he has made loose the cord of my bow, and put me to shame; he has sent down my flag to the earth before me.

entries.title: Job 30:12
segments: The lines of his men of war put themselves in order, and make high their ways of destruction against me:

entries.title: Job 30:13
segments: They have made waste my roads, with a view to my destruction; his bowmen come round about me;

entries.title: Job 30:14
segments: As through a wide broken place in the wall they come on, I am overturned by the shock of their attack.

entries.title: Job 30:15
segments: ¶Fears have come on me; my hope is gone like the wind, and my well-being like a cloud.

entries.title: Job 30:16
segments: But now my soul is turned to water in me, days of trouble overtake me:

entries.title: Job 30:17
segments: The flesh is gone from my bones, and they give me no rest; there is no end to my pains.

entries.title: Job 30:18
segments: With great force he takes a grip of my clothing, pulling me by the neck of my coat.

entries.title: Job 30:19
segments: Truly God has made me low, even to the earth, and I have become like dust.

entries.title: Job 30:20
segments: You give no answer to my cry, and take no note of my prayer.

entries.title: Job 30:21
segments: You have become cruel to me; the strength of your hand is hard on me.

entries.title: Job 30:22
segments: Lifting me up, you make me go on the wings of the wind; I am broken up by the storm.

entries.title: Job 30:23
segments: For I am certain that you will send me back to death, and to the meeting-place ordered for all living.

entries.title: Job 30:24
segments: Has not my hand been stretched out in help to the poor? have I not been a saviour to him in his trouble?

entries.title: Job 30:25
segments: Have I not been weeping for the crushed? and was not my soul sad for him who was in need?

entries.title: Job 30:26
segments: For I was looking for good, and evil came; I was waiting for light, and it became dark.

entries.title: Job 30:27
segments: My feelings are strongly moved, and give me no rest; days of trouble have overtaken me.

entries.title: Job 30:28
segments: I go about in dark clothing, uncomforted; I get up in the public place, crying out for help.

entries.title: Job 30:29
segments: I have become a brother to the jackals, and go about in the company of ostriches.

entries.title: Job 30:30
segments: My skin is black and dropping off me; and my bones are burning with the heat of my disease.

entries.title: Job 30:31
segments: And my music has been turned to sorrow, and the sound of my pipe into the noise of weeping.
